meaning:
Ἀσιάρχης, -ου, ὁ
an Asiarch, one of ten officers elected by the various cities in the province of Asia whose duty it was to celebrate at their own charges the public games and festivals: Act.19:31 (Strab., Inscr.; DB, see word).†
(AS)
glosses: officials of the province of asia

renderings.bsb: officials of the province of Asia

elsewhere.note: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.
